title: User Perceptions of Security in Ride-Sharing: An Extended ASE Framework
content: The article explores the popularity of ride-sharing in Dhaka City and validates the ASE model with personal innovativeness and perceived trust. Data was collected from Dhaka citizens aged 18 to 65, and 355 valid responses were used for the study. The analysis found all proposed hypotheses to be significant, with attitude and social influence having the highest and lowest effects.
